# Daniel VLKO

> Daniel VLKO is a Software Developer & Automation Architect building scalable digital systems that help businesses operate faster, reduce manual work and scale more efficiently.

Daniel VLKO designs and develops custom software, business automation systems, AI-assisted workflows and digital platforms.

The focus is on practical business outcomes: reducing repetitive work, improving operational efficiency, connecting processes and creating scalable digital infrastructure.

The official website is https://danielvlko.com/.
